stops.name: Traunstein
stops.quote: One highlight is the distinctive Traunstein, which rises to 1,691 metres and offers a challenging day hike with panoramic views of the surrounding peaks.
stops.english: One highlight is the distinctive Traunstein, which rises to 1,691 metres and offers a challenging day hike with panoramic views of the surrounding peaks.

stops.name: Seeschloss Ort
stops.quote: Seeschloss Ort, located on a small island in Lake Traunsee, is one of the oldest buildings in the Salzkammergut.
stops.english: Seeschloss Ort, located on a small island in Lake Traunsee, is one of the oldest buildings in the Salzkammergut.

stops.name: Gmunden
stops.quote: Gmunden, the most well-known town on Traunsee, lies on the northern shore, while Ebensee is located on the southern shore.
stops.english: Gmunden, the most well-known town on Traunsee, lies on the northern shore, while Ebensee is located on the southern shore.

stops.name: Grünberg
stops.quote: Handicrafts, regional cuisine, boat trips on the lake and the ‘Lichterzauber’ light display on the Grünberg are just some of the many Advent attractions on offer.
stops.english: Handicrafts, regional cuisine, boat trips on the lake and the ‘Lichterzauber’ light display on the Grünberg are just some of the many Advent attractions on offer.
